description: Fix ModelSelect Popover broken by Headless UI v2 mismatch + improve AI Settings page layout and provider list UX

tasks.title: Fix ModelSelect Popover — remove Transition wrapper
tasks.description: In AiSettingsSection.tsx, remove the `Transition` wrapper around `Popover.Panel` (line 257–265 and closing line 322). Render `Popover.Panel` directly as a child of `Popover`. Remove the unused `Transition` import from `@headlessui/react` and `Fragment` import from React if only used by `Transition as={Fragment}`.
acceptanceCriteria: Mohist Model selector button click renders the Popover.Panel DOM with model list
Coder Model selector opens and displays selectable models
Stage Model Override selectors open after expanding the section
Clear button (X) appears when allowClear is set and a value is selected, and clears the value on click
No Transition import remains in the file
tasks.notes: Root cause fix. This alone unblocks all model selection on the AI Settings page.

tasks.title: Restructure AI Settings layout and add collapsible provider groups
tasks.description: In AiSettingsSection.tsx, reorder sections so Model Selection and Stage Model Overrides appear above Providers (per web-ui layout spec). Split the provider list into two visual groups: configured providers (always expanded) and unconfigured providers (default collapsed with count badge). Add a `unconfiguredExpanded` state (default false). The existing `providerSearch` and `filteredProviders` logic continues to filter across both groups.
acceptanceCriteria: Model Selection section renders at the top of the page, Providers section below it
Configured providers display under a 'Configured' group header, always expanded
Unconfigured providers display under an 'Available Providers (N)' header, collapsed by default
Clicking the 'Available Providers' header toggles expand/collapse
Empty 'Configured' group is hidden when no providers are configured
Provider search filters both groups correctly
tasks.notes: All changes are in the same file. T-001 fixes the popover first so layout changes are verifiable.
